title: Enderite Update
description: This project add Enderite and Didier! I know that there is a lot of Enderite mod, but why not try mine?(If you found a bug, pls report to me in the comment).The added Items are in the description.
body:
This is a mod adding Enderite tools and a new custom boss Didier (of FuzeIII), to make him spawn you need 1 obsidian and 1 carved pumpkin. The enderite ore spawn in the end, once you smelt one, all the possible recipes unlock.
Here are the added Items: -Enderite Armor, Sword, Axe, Pickaxe, Hoe, Shovel, Totem, Block, Ore, Bow and more.
